name: Twilight Princess

features.name: Cluster pays
features.description: Five or more adjacent symbols win on a 5x5 grid.

features.name: Sticky free spins
features.description: 10 free spins where wilds stick and the princess can add more.

review:
A 5x5 cluster game with bells, flowers and a princess. Five or more touching symbols win, and wilds with multipliers up to 10x help complete clusters.

Three scatters give 10 free spins where every wild sticks for the rest of the round – and the princess can randomly add extra sticky multiplier wilds at any time. A lighter alternative to Pragmatic's bigger cluster games. Up to 7,500x, 96.08% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
